$comment: WHAT LEVEL AM I. Third version, 2026-08-22. The first was too strict, he said so, and he was
right. This one is built on a REAL adult ladder instead of multipliers an agent invented.
THE DISAGREEMENT AND HOW IT RESOLVED. He had a table from another conversation that put him
between Fitness and Club. My first build put him at Recreational, two rungs lower. Both were
true, of different populations, and neither of us noticed that was the actual question:
- His table scored him against EVERYONE WHO SWIMS. On that, a regular lap swimmer with
reasonable technique is a fitness swimmer, and he is one.
- Mine scored him against PEOPLE WHO RACE, by deriving tiers from the US Masters national
qualifying time. On that, he is below the bottom.
He also had one real error, and it is small: his table was LONG course, 50 m. His pool is 25 m,
freestyle is about 3% faster short course, so reading his own times straight off a long-course
table flattered him by roughly half a tier.
WHAT THIS VERSION USES. He found Openlane, which publishes masters motivational times by age
group. Its top rung, AAAA, is EXACTLY the official USMS national qualifying time at all six
distances, and the rungs below step down by a fixed fraction: AAAA plus k/21 for k of 0, 1, 2,
3, 5, 7, so the slowest rung B is four thirds of the qualifying time. That was checked at every
distance before any of it was used, and it held to four decimal places.
Openlane is an independent analytics project, NOT US Masters Swimming, and says so itself. So
those rungs are marked `third-party`: better than a number we picked, weaker than the two
sourced rungs above them.
ONE RUNG IS STILL OURS. B is faster than him at every distance, so without a rung below it he
would not appear on his own page. `fitness` is B times 1.20 and is labelled `constructed`.
THE USEFUL NUMBER, and it is the reason this rebuild was worth doing: he is 4.5% off the bottom
rung of the real masters ladder at 1500 m, and 18.6% off it at 100 m. That is a target with a
distance attached, which "Recreational" was not.
COURSE. Everything on this page is short course 25 m, his pool. The Openlane rows are published
long course and are divided by 1.03 to get there; that conversion is flagged on every rung it
touches. The two sourced rungs are natively short course and are not converted.
3 km AND 5 km ARE NOT POOL EVENTS and no ladder exists for them at any level. Extrapolated from
the 1500, and flagged at every rung.
